raw.description:
Key Responsibilities:

  • Responsible for the development of industrial accounts assigned, in compliance with sales and finance policies and all legal and technical standards.
  • Responsible for managing and growing assigned B2B corporate accounts through effective hunting and farming strategies—identifying and converting new prospects into customers to expand the customer base, while nurturing existing accounts to strengthen relationships, ensure customer retention, maximize account potential, and drive sustainable sales growth.
  • Implements ILC policies, B2B account development initiatives and strategies.
  • Implements and executes business reviews and business plans with B2B key accounts.
  • Manages and monitors volume on a daily, weekly, and monthly basis, providing timely feedback and guidance to the Line Manager & B2B Sales Team.
  • Develops & implements weekly & monthly activity plans & sales strategies, providing regular progress updates & performance feedback to the Line Manager.
  • Monitors monthly credit dues & ensures timely collection of receivables to minimize overdue accounts.
  • Implements actions proposed by the business and /or by the Line Manager and reports timely about the results of these actions.
  • Monitors industrial installations after contract signature (verifies compliance with safety regulations and tightness tests for installations).
  • Plan, monitor, and achieve individual and team sales targets.
  • Develops, updates, and maintains customer account strategies for assigned B2B key accounts, documents all customer interactions, and plans and allocates activities to effectively address customer needs and achieve business objectives.
  • Be responsible and proactive on HSSE issues that affect the individual, the office environment and all B2B customers.
  • Be accountable for own development plans to continuously improve competencies (knowledge / skill / behavior).
  • Define and execute the overall business plan (including call plans) for all customers in the portfolio.
  • Monitors competitor activities and implements strategies to counter them.
  • Ensure all service providers carry out the agreed terms.
  • Actively use available systems optimally and keep customer contacts up to date and / or actively ensure accuracy where others perform these tasks.
  • Provide backup within the sales force when required.
  • Ensures all customer contracts are updated and enforced. Responsible for development of team members' individual competencies.

Qualifications:

  • Ability to plan and execute B2B corporate account development and transformation strategies to drive revenue growth, strengthen customer partnerships, and expand market penetration
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in sales, preferably in the Oil and Gas industry or similar
  • High personal effectiveness, able to command respect without direct authority
  • Ability to work independently with minimum supervision and support
  • Prior experience in the B2B segment is strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated Enterprise First mindset and actions (looking beyond department silo and contributing to business unit / ILC bottom line)

AboutIPGG

Isla Petroleum and Gas Corporation (IPGG)is a joint venture between Isla Petroleum & Energy (IP&E) and CREASIA Energy Holdings, focused on LPG and energy ventures within the Isla Group. Acquired from Shell in 2012, IPGG is now aleading LPG distributor in the Philippines, operating across the supply chain—from importation and trading to marketing and distribution. Through its subsidiaryIsla LPG Corporation, it rebranded Shellane toSolane, now the#1 LPG brand in consumer preference.

IPGG also supports fuel conversion systems and piped LPG solutions nationwide. Its other subsidiaries,Isla Gas Terminals (ILG)andIsla Import Terminals (IITI), further strengthen its infrastructure and logistics capabilities. IPGG plays a vital role in advancing safe, reliable, and accessible energy solutions across the country.

We offer a competitive total rewards package which includes a base salary determined by factors such as role, experience, skill set, and location. Additionally, eligible employees may receive discretionary bonuses based on both company performance and individual achievements. Our benefits and programs are designed to meet the needs of our employees and are benchmarked to the market. Detailed information regarding compensation and benefits will be shared during the hiring process.

raw.description:
Dies ist ein Remote Job.

Einer der größten Wachstumsmärkte unserer Zeit
Pflege gehört zu den am stärksten wachsenden Märkten in Deutschland.
Die Nachfrage steigt kontinuierlich – Lösungen werden dringend gebraucht.
Diese Lösung gibt es - 24 Stunden Betreuung zu Hause.
Gesucht werden vertriebsstarke Partner, die aktiv mitgetstalten wollen. Erfahrung im Bereich Pflege ist nicht notwendig.
Der deutsche Pflegemarkt steuert nicht auf Krise zu - er steckt mitten in einem beispiellosen Strukturwandel. Während klassische Pflegeheime heute bereits 60.000 Betten leer stehen lassen müssen, weil sie schlicht kein Personal mehr finden, explodiert die Zahl der Pflegebedürftigen auf über 5,6 Millionen. Ergebnis - ein massives Versorgungs-Vakuum. Familien stehen vor verschlossenen Heimtüren, während 80% der Betroffenen ohnehin zu Hause würdevoll altern wollen.
Werde als selbständoger Partner zum Architekten einer Lösung, die skalierbar ist, in einem Business mit Sinn.
Deine Aufgabe
  • Beratung von Familien in einer konkreten Bedarfssituation
  • Aufbau eines eigenen Vertriebsgebiets
  • aktive Kundengewinnung und Gesprächsführung
  • Durchführung von Beratungsgesprächen bis zum Abschluss

Fokus: Gespräche führen. Lösungen anbieten. Abschlüsse machen.


Voraussetzungen

  • Vertriebserfahrung (z. B. Versicherung, Immobilien, Beratung oder ähnlich)
  • sicheres Auftreten im Gespräch
  • Eigeninitiative und Abschlussstärke
  • Bereitschaft, aktiv auf Menschen zuzugehen
  • hohe lernbereitschaft​
  • Empathie

kein Pflegehintergrund erforderlich


Vorteile

  • Zugang zu einem stark wachsenden Markt
  • ein erprobtes Geschäftsmodell
  • klare Strukturen und einfache Prozesse
  • praxisnahe Schulung (Vertrieb, Produkt, Markt)
  • aktive Unterstützung bei Gesprächen und Abschlüssen
  • Zugriff auf erfahrene Vertriebsmanager
  • Einblick in echte Verkaufsgespräche
Melde dich einfach bei uns und lass uns gemeinsam schauen, ob dieser Markt dir eine Zukunft bieten kann.

raw.excerpt: Job OverviewWe are seeking a highly experienced Senior Linux Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in Linux administration, bare metal infrastructure, enterprise storage, and next-generation AI Factory / GPU infrastructure platforms.
raw.description:
Job Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Senior Linux Infrastructure Engineer with deep expertise in Linux administration, bare metal infrastructure, enterprise storage, and next-generation AI Factory / GPU infrastructure platforms. This role is focused on designing, deploying, operating, and troubleshooting large-scale Linux-based infrastructure that powers both traditional enterprise workloads and modern AI/ML environments.

This is not a DevOps-focused role. We already have a dedicated DevOps team and are looking for an engineer with extensive hands-on experience in Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS), GPU infrastructure, high-performance storage, data center operations, and enterprise Linux platforms.

The ideal candidate will have experience building and managing infrastructure from the hardware layer up, including servers, networking, storage, GPU clusters, and AI-ready platforms. They should be comfortable working with high-performance computing (HPC), AI Factory environments, and large-scale Linux deployments where performance, reliability, and operational excellence are critical.

Key Responsibilities & Required Skills

Linux & Bare Metal Infrastructure

  • Expert-level Linux administration (Ubuntu required; Red Hat and SUSE preferred)
  • Deep expertise in bare metal server deployment, architecture, provisioning, and lifecycle management
  • Experience operating Bare Metal as a Service (BMaaS) platforms and large-scale infrastructure environments
  • Strong understanding of server hardware, including:
    • BIOS/UEFI
    • RAID controllers
    • Firmware management
    • iLO/iDRAC/IPMI
    • NICs and SmartNICs
    • HBA cards
    • Hardware diagnostics and troubleshooting
  • Experience designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise Linux infrastructure at scale

AI Factory & GPU Infrastructure

  • Experience deploying and managing GPU-accelerated infrastructure for AI/ML workloads
  • Understanding of NVIDIA GPU technologies including:
    • A100, H100, H200, B200, or equivalent GPU platforms
    • NVIDIA DGX and OEM GPU servers
    • GPU provisioning and lifecycle management
    • GPU monitoring and performance optimization
  • Knowledge of AI Factory architecture and infrastructure requirements
  • Experience supporting GPU clusters, AI training environments, and high-performance computing (HPC) workloads
  • Understanding of:
    • GPU resource allocation and scheduling
    • Multi-GPU systems
    • GPU networking requirements
    • High-bandwidth, low-latency infrastructure design
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA ecosystem technologies such as:
    • CUDA
    • NCCL
    • GPUDirect Storage
    • NVIDIA Fabric Manager
    • NVIDIA Base Command (preferred)

Enterprise Storage & Data Platforms

  • Advanced Linux storage administration:
    • LVM
    • XFS, EXT4
    • NFS
    • iSCSI
    • Fibre Channel SAN
    • Multipath I/O
  • Strong hands-on experience with Ceph, including:
    • Cluster architecture
    • MON, OSD, MDS
    • RBD, CephFS, RGW
    • Capacity planning
    • Performance tuning
    • Failure recovery
  • Experience with high-performance AI storage platforms such as:
    • WEKA
    • VAST Data
    • Dell PowerScale
    • Pure Storage FlashBlade
    • NetApp
  • Understanding of:
    • NVMe-over-Fabrics (NVMe-oF)
    • RDMA
    • GPUDirect Storage
    • Parallel file systems
    • AI data pipelines

Networking & Infrastructure

  • Strong networking knowledge:
    • Bonding
    • VLANs
    • Routing
    • MTU optimization
    • DNS
    • DHCP
  • Experience with high-performance data center networking:
    • 100G/200G/400G Ethernet
    • RoCE
    • RDMA
    • Spine-Leaf architectures
  • Familiarity with NVIDIA Spectrum-X, Mellanox/NVIDIA ConnectX adapters, or equivalent technologies
  • Strong understanding of Layer 2 and Layer 3 infrastructure design and troubleshooting

Operations & Reliability

  • Experience with high availability, clustering, and disaster recovery
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across:
    • Linux operating systems
    • Hardware platforms
    • GPU infrastructure
    • Networking
    • Enterprise storage
  • Experience supporting mission-critical production environments
  • Bash and Python scripting for automation and operational efficiency
  • Experience creating operational documentation, runbooks, and infrastructure standards
  • Understanding of AI infrastructure design and reference architectures
  • AI cloud integration for workloads
  • SOP and runbook development and maintenance
  • Incident, problem, and capacity management
  • Business continuity and disaster recovery planning for AI workloads
  • Proactive risk identification and mitigation to avoid business impact

Nice to Have

  • Kubernetes infrastructure (especially AI/ML and GPU integration)
  • KVM, VMware, OpenShift Virtualization, or similar virtualization platforms
  • Ansible automation
  • NVIDIA Base Command Manager
  • Slurm or HPC workload schedulers
  • Observability and monitoring platforms (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
  • Data Center Infrastructure Management (DCIM) tools
  • IPAM solutions
  • AWS, Azure, or hybrid cloud exposure

We Are Not Looking For

  • Candidates whose experience is primarily CI/CD pipeline engineering
  • Engineers focused mainly on Terraform, GitOps, or application delivery pipelines
  • Cloud-only administrators with limited bare metal, storage, or hardware experience
  • Professionals whose primary expertise is software development rather than infrastructure engineering

Ideal Candidate

Someone who has spent years designing, building, and operating enterprise Linux environments, large-scale bare metal infrastructure, storage platforms, and modern AI Factory environments. The ideal candidate understands how to deploy and manage GPU-enabled infrastructure, BMaaS platforms, enterprise storage, and high-performance networking while solving complex operating system, hardware, storage, and AI infrastructure challenges. DevOps experience is a plus, but deep Linux, infrastructure, storage, BMaaS, and AI Factory expertise is the primary requirement.

raw.description:
CX Support Agent - Level 1

Join a growing SaaS support team helping mission-driven organizations get more value from the software they use every day.

This is a remote, Philippines-based Level 1 customer support role for a software company serving nonprofits, hospitals, governments, and other volunteer-powered organizations. You will be the first human support layer after AI-assisted triage, helping customers resolve practical software questions through chat, email, phone, and screen-sharing support.

The best fit is patient, detail-oriented, fluent in professional English, comfortable learning new software quickly, and energized by helping users who may not be deeply technical.

What You Will Do

  • Monitor and manage Level 1 support requests during your assigned coverage hours.
  • Respond to customer questions through chat, email, phone, and screen-sharing sessions.
  • Troubleshoot software, account, workflow, and usage-related questions.
  • Help customers understand how to use the product in clear, simple language.
  • Escalate complex issues to Level 2, product, data, or technical teams when needed.
  • Process account changes, upgrades, downgrades, and general company inquiries when assigned.
  • Maintain clear, empathetic, and accurate written communication.
  • Stay engaged during the shift and contribute to team check-ins, handoffs, and support coverage.

What We Are Looking For

  • Full professional English fluency, both written and verbal.
  • Prior customer support, help desk, BPO, SaaS, software, or technical support experience.
  • Strong written communication with excellent grammar, clarity, and attention to detail.
  • Patience and empathy when supporting users with different levels of technical confidence.
  • Ability to simplify software questions and explain steps clearly.
  • Comfort working with support tools such as Intercom, HubSpot, Zendesk, Freshdesk, or similar systems.
  • Strong organization, time management, follow-through, and prioritization.
  • Ability to work independently from home while staying active in team communication.
  • Reliable remote-work setup and stable internet.

Nice To Have

  • Experience supporting SaaS or software products.
  • Experience with Intercom or HubSpot.
  • Experience supporting nonprofit, volunteer-management, CRM, scheduling, training, communications, or compliance software.
  • Experience using metrics such as response time, resolution quality, customer satisfaction, ticket volume, or escalation rate.
  • Prior remote work experience with North American, UK, European, or Australian customers.

Schedule

There are two openings. Candidates must be based in the Philippines and able to work one of these remote schedules:

  • EMEA shift: 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM UTC, which is 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM PHT.
  • AMER shift: 5:00 PM to 1:00 AM UTC, which is 1:00 AM to 9:00 AM PHT.

Contracted hours follow UTC and do not change for local daylight savings time.

Compensation

USD $1,000 to $1,300 per month, based on experience and fit.

Why This Role

This is a chance to join a growing global support function at an important moment. The company is building a stronger Level 1 and Level 2 support model, and strong performers may have opportunities to grow as the team scales.

You will support customers doing meaningful work in their communities, and your work will directly affect whether they can use their systems confidently and efficiently.

Interview Process

Qualified candidates will complete a video interview with Urrly. The strongest candidates may also complete a practical assessment focused on written communication, attention to detail, and customer-support judgment.

Apply now and get a response within 24 hours.

Salary: $1,000 – $1,300 / month

Job Title: Sr Manager, Empaveli Publications - US Medical Affairs

Job Location: Remote, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

About This Role:


As Senior Manager, Scientific Communications within Global Medical Affairs, you will support the development and execution of the global publications strategy for Empaveli across nephrology and hematology indications. (80% nephrology / 20% hematology)

You will translate scientific and medical priorities into high-quality publication plans and deliverables, working closely with cross-functional colleagues, external authors, and medical communications agencies. You will also contribute to the development of scientific platforms and ensure that publications are scientifically accurate, strategically aligned, delivered on time, and developed in accordance with Biogen standard operating procedures and industry publication standards.


What You’ll Do:


  • Support the development, maintenance, and execution of global strategic publication plans for Empaveli across nephrology and hematology.
  • Contribute to the development and refinement of core scientific platforms, communication objectives, and evidence-based scientific statements.
  • Lead individual publication projects from concept through submission and publication, including manuscripts, congress abstracts, posters, oral presentations, and related scientific materials.
  • Coordinate cross-functional publication teams and facilitate alignment among Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Biostatistics, Health Economics and Outcomes Research, Regulatory, and other relevant functions.
  • Partner with internal and external authors to develop scientifically accurate, clear, and strategically aligned publications.
  • Monitor the scientific literature and congress landscape, providing timely summaries of relevant publications, competitive developments, and emerging evidence.
  • Manage medical communications agencies and other external vendors, including project planning, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality oversight.
  • Track publication plan progress, identify risks or delays, and recommend practical solutions to support timely execution.
  • Ensure that externally presented or published materials align with the global publication plan and comply with Biogen policies, applicable standard operating procedures, and recognized publication practices.
  • Support publication team meetings, author communications, documentation, and approval processes.
  • Contribute to annual publication planning, budget development, and forecasting.
  • Provide publication-related guidance to colleagues and support the development of less-experienced team members, as appropriate.

Who You Are:


You are an experienced medical affairs or scientific communications professional with strong scientific judgment and a record of successfully managing complex publication projects. You communicate clearly, work effectively across functions, and are comfortable managing multiple priorities in a matrixed environment. You combine attention to scientific detail with strong project-management skills and can independently advance projects while recognizing when strategic alignment or senior-level input is needed.


Required Skills:


  • PharmD, PhD, or MD in a relevant life science field.
  • 2+ years of experience within Medical Affairs in the pharmaceutical/biotech industry, including publications planning experience.
  • Proven track record in scientific communications and publications planning.
  • Exceptional project management abilities.
  • Strong ability to work effectively in a matrix environment.
  • Superior scientific acumen and communication skills.

Preferred Skills:


  • Experience in Nephrology and/or Hematology.
  • Demonstrated leadership in cross-functional project management.
  • Experience managing external vendors and overseeing project budgets.

Why Biogen?


We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: -

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)

  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. La empresa se dedica a la gestión y operación de una granja agroturística, brindando experiencias auténticas en el entorno rural. Además, se encarga de organizar eventos y promover la agricultura sostenible en la región.

Requisitos

DESCRIPCIÓN Y REQUERIMIENTOS ESPECIFICOS

Formación académica específica o general (competencias duras):

  • Profesional en Administración de Empresas, Negocios internacionales, Turismo o campos relacionados.
  • Conocimientos sólidos en marketing, especialmente en temas de mercadeo digital, comercio digital, redes sociales y posicionamiento web.
  • Experiencia en la gestión de auditorías de seguros (servicios turísticos) y contratación de personal.
  • Conocimiento de la estructura de la contabilidad y las finanzas, análisis y gestion de las mismas.
  • Dominio de las aplicaciones de Google y herramientas informáticas relacionadas con el negocio.
  • Gestión de los listados en Airbnb y otras plataformas de alquiler, incluyendo la creación y actualización de los listados, la fijación de precios y la respuesta a las consultas.
  • Especialista en generación de demanda se enfocará en campañas de marketing para atraer a turistas locales y extranjeros.

Años de experiencia y conocimientos específicos necesarios:

  • Mínimo 3 años de experiencia en administración hotelera y/o agroturística.
  • Experiencia en supervisión de tareas administrativas en fincas/agroturismo y gestión de producción agrícola.
  • Capacidad para revisar y controlar las finanzas y garantizar la viabilidad de cada aspecto de la granja.
  • Experiencia en gestión de alquileres y control de gastos a corto y medio plazo .

Funciones principales:

  • Liderar la estrategia tecnológica y de automatización de procesos en la plataforma, con énfasis en marketing digital y comercio electrónico.
  • Supervisar las tareas administrativas de la finca/agroturismo, incluyendo la gestión del personal y la producción agrícola para maximizar la rentabilidad.
  • Coordinar eventos y planificar viajes de campo.
  • Organizar y gestionar el correo electrónico y otros procesos administrativos.
  • Pasión por la agricultura y habilidades administrativas.

Factores principales de personalidad (competencias blandas):

  • Excelentes habilidades de organización y gestión del tiempo.
  • Capacidad para trabajar de manera autónoma y en equipo.
  • Habilidades de comunicación efectiva.
  • Orientación al detalle y capacidad para mantener altos estándares de calidad.
  • Resolución de problemas y toma de decisiones efectivas.

Conocimientos deseables más importantes:

  • Marketing digital y comercio electrónico: El administrador debe tener conocimientos sólidos en estrategias de marketing digital y comercio electrónico para promover la granja, atraer clientes y maximizar la visibilidad en línea.
  • Gestión de finanzas y contabilidad: Comprender la estructura de la contabilidad y tener habilidades en la gestión financiera es esencial para supervisar las finanzas de la granja, evaluar la rentabilidad de los aspectos clave y tomar decisiones financieras informadas.
  • Administración hotelera agroturística: Conocer los aspectos específicos de la administración de un negocio agroturístico, incluyendo la gestión de eventos, alojamiento, alimentación y actividades relacionadas, es fundamental para garantizar una experiencia exitosa para los visitantes.
  • Agricultura y producción agropecuaria: Contar con conocimientos en agricultura, producción de alimentos y manejo de animales es crucial para comprender las necesidades de la granja agroturística y asegurar una gestión adecuada de los recursos naturales y la producción agrícola.
  • Tecnología y herramientas digitales: Estar al tanto de las últimas herramientas tecnológicas, aplicaciones móviles y software de gestión agrícola es importante para mejorar la eficiencia operativa, automatizar procesos y optimizar la experiencia del cliente.

Habilidades de liderazgo y gestión:

raw.description:
​This is a paid freelance and remote position.

ScreenRant is the #1 entertainment website and publishes breaking news and exclusives on blockbuster movies, TV shows, comic books, and other forms of entertainment.

As a worldwide leader, ScreenRant operates at a rapid pace and is always looking for experienced and passionate contributors who can create original high-quality content in a timely manner.

Your Responsibilities:

  • Write timely streaming news and streaming chart articles in ScreenRant's house style (following the initial training period), optimized for Google Discover. This includes fact-checking, formatting, linking, and image sourcing/very basic editing (sizing, brightness, etc.)
  • Track and quickly turn around coverage of streaming performance data — Netflix Top 10, Nielsen streaming rankings, FlixPatrol, and platform-reported viewership — translating charts and numbers into compelling, reader-friendly stories
  • Monitor Netflix, Disney+, Max, Prime Video, Apple TV+, Hulu, Peacock, and other services for breaking news, new additions, leaving titles, renewals, cancellations, and trending viewership moments
  • Craft Discover-optimized headlines and framing that capture reader curiosity and search intent without resorting to clickbait
  • Update and refresh older content to keep it current as charts shift and titles move on and off platforms
  • Accept and apply any/all feedback received by the editorial team
  • Communicate openly and actively with the editorial team
  • Flexible schedule, afternoon (PST) work schedule preferred, weekend availability valued

What We Offer:

  • Competitive compensation.
  • Consistent and timely payments.
  • Flexible schedule.
  • Remote freelance position to work from a location of your choice.
  • Exposure to ScreenRant's large and passionate audience, providing you an exciting opportunity to make a genuine impact.

Experience and Skills:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Journalism, English Literature, or a related field
  • Broad working knowledge of Movies and TV and the entertainment industry as a whole — across multiple genres
  • Strong familiarity with the streaming landscape: the major platforms, their release strategies, and how streaming performance is measured and reported
    • Experience interpreting streaming charts and viewership data is a strong plus
  • An understanding of Google Discover and what drives engagement on the platform is a plus
  • 2+ years of experience working with a credible digital publication
  • A quick learner with a strong sense of urgency and drive
  • An excellent writer in the English language free of grammatical and spelling errors
  • The ability to write high quality articles with fast turnaround times
  • Comfortable working in a fully remote environment

​

How to Apply:

If you are interested in this role, please send us the following documentation by uploading it in the relevant fields below:

  • Your CV

We look forward to hearing from you!​

Our hiring team will review your application and contact you if we believe that your experience could be a match for this role.

Please note that a writing evaluation may be required as part of our application process.

ScreenRant is part of the Valnet Publishing Group.


​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​

Valnet , founded in 2012, is a global digital publishing and media investment Company that owns and operates over 25 authoritative brands across diverse verticals, including entertainment, sports, technology, automotive, gaming, lifestyle and travel.

Valnet is committed to producing premium content, and we therefore require all our contributors to adhere to our Editorial Standards, including a prohibition on using Artificial Intelligence.

The role focuses on creating measurable positive outcomes for communities, stakeholders, customers, employees, and the environment while aligning impact objectives with the organization's long-term business strategy. The CIO drives programs that enhance corporate responsibility, sustainable growth, and stakeholder value.

Key Responsibilities

Impact Strategy & Vision

  • Develop and execute the organization's impact strategy aligned with corporate mission and business objectives.
  • Define measurable social, environmental, and economic impact goals.
  • Integrate impact priorities into enterprise-wide strategic planning.

ESG & Sustainability Leadership

  • Lead ESG, sustainability, and corporate social responsibility (CSR) initiatives.
  • Ensure alignment of impact programs with sustainability frameworks and best practices.
  • Drive initiatives focused on climate action, social inclusion, and responsible governance.

Social Impact & Community Engagement

  • Develop programs that create meaningful impact within communities and stakeholder groups.
  • Lead partnerships with nonprofits, NGOs, government agencies, and community organizations.
  • Oversee philanthropic initiatives, volunteer programs, and social investment projects.

Impact Measurement & Reporting

  • Establish frameworks to measure and evaluate social and environmental impact.
  • Develop KPIs, dashboards, and reporting structures for impact performance.
  • Communicate outcomes and progress to leadership, investors, and stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement & Partnerships

  • Engage with investors, clients, regulators, community leaders, and advocacy groups.
  • Build strategic partnerships that strengthen organizational impact and reputation.
  • Represent the organization in sustainability and impact-focused forums.

Sustainable Business Integration

  • Collaborate with business units to embed impact principles into products, services, and operations.
  • Support responsible investment and sustainable business initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to create shared value through innovation and strategic growth.

Governance & Compliance

  • Ensure compliance with ESG, sustainability, and social responsibility standards and regulations.
  • Establish governance frameworks to support accountability and transparency.
  • Coordinate with legal, compliance, and risk management teams.

Employee Engagement & Culture

  • Promote a purpose-driven and socially responsible organizational culture.
  • Drive employee engagement initiatives related to sustainability and social impact.
  • Foster diversity, equity, inclusion, and employee well-being programs.

Leadership & Organizational Development

  • Lead and mentor sustainability, CSR, ESG, and impact teams.
  • Build cross-functional collaboration around impact initiatives.
  • Drive innovation and continuous improvement in impact strategies.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Sustainability, Public Policy, Business Administration, Social Sciences, or related field; Master's degree preferred.
  • 12–15+ years of experience in ESG, sustainability, social impact, CSR, or related leadership roles.
  • Proven experience developing and implementing impact-focused initiatives and strategies.
  • Strong understanding of ESG frameworks, sustainability reporting, and stakeholder engagement.

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong strategic and purpose-driven leadership skills.
  • Expertise in ESG, sustainability, and social impact measurement.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication abilities.
  • Strong analytical and program management skills.
  • Change management and cross-functional collaboration capabilities.

Performance Metrics

  • Achievement of social and environmental impact goals.
  • ESG and sustainability performance outcomes.
  • Community engagement and partnership effectiveness.
  • Employee participation and culture engagement metrics.
  • Stakeholder trust, reputation, and impact reporting success.

This is a senior, hands-on technical role. You will serve as the primary OCI architect on client engagements: owning solution design end-to-end, guiding technical decisions, and delivering production-grade implementations. No people management responsibilities.
As OCI Architect you will be engaging with various customers in their cloud enablement initiatives. The candidate will be involved in design and execution of cloud migration strategy, automating existing cloud workloads in cloud, provide services to port existing workloads to leverage cloud benefits.
Requirements:
  • 10+ years of experience in customer-facing infrastructure or cloud architecture roles
  • 5+ years of hands-on OCI design and implementation experience

Location: 100% Remote
Job Type: Full Time employee, CTH, or Contract
  • Architect end-to-end OCI solutions for customer engagements spanning landing zone design, network topology, identity, compute, storage, and database tiers
  • Lead Oracle Database workload migrations to OCI, including Exadata Cloud Service, Autonomous Database (ADB), and Base Database Service, with a focus on performance, HA, and DR
  • Design and execute Oracle Applications migrations (EBS, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards) to OCI, including lift-and-shift and modernization patterns
  • Architect and deploy AI/Data Platform (AIDP) workloads leveraging OCI GenAI Service, OCI AI Agents, OCI Data Science, and Oracle Database 23ai Vector Search

OCI Core Services

  • Storage: Block Volume, File Storage (FSS), Object Storage (lifecycle, replication, versioning), Local NVMe
  • IAM: compartment hierarchy, policies, dynamic groups, federated identity (SAML/SCIM), OCI Vault, Bastion Service
  • Kubernetes: OKE cluster provisioning, node pool management, cluster networking (flannel/NPN), OCI Container Registry (OCIR)

Oracle Database & Exadata
  • Autonomous Database (ADB-S, ADB-D), Base Database Service, Exadata Cloud Service, Exadata Cloud@Customer
  • Data Guard (Maximum Availability, Maximum Performance), GoldenGate for live migration and zero-downtime cutovers

  • Database migration tools: MV2ADB, Data Pump, ZDLRA, Database Migration Service (DMS)

Oracle Applications (Migrations to OCI)
  • EBS 12.1/12.2 on OCI: architecture patterns, shared file system design, wallet-based DB connectivity or similar Oracle Application experience, like Peoplesoft or JDE.

AI / GenAI / Data Platform
  • OCI Generative AI Service: Cohere and Meta model endpoints, embedding models, semantic search patterns
  • OCI AI Agents: agent frameworks, tool configuration, RAG pipelines, knowledge base integration
  • OCI Data Science: model deployment, JupyterLab environments, ML pipelines, Aqua (AI Quick Actions)
  • Oracle Database 23ai Vector Search: VECTOR data type, HNSW/IVF indexes, vector distance functions

Technical Skills — Preferred
  • Multi-cloud connectivity: OCI–Azure Interconnect, OCI–AWS, Oracle Database@Azure, Oracle Database@AWS
  • Oracle WebLogic Server on OCI / WebLogic for OKE
  • ZFS Storage Appliance on OCI, Oracle Linux, RHEL administration at scale

Preferred Qualifications

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure 2024 Generative AI Professional (1Z0-1127) - preferred

Education

What Sets This Role Apart
You will work on OCI exclusively with ability to learn and engage with emerging technologies like multi-cloud architecture, Agentic AI and Generative AI. Centroid's clients engage us because of deep Oracle expertise, you will architect solutions that Oracle's own SCs reference, participate in Oracle partner programs, and shape how enterprise customers realize value from OCI's most advanced capabilities. If you are an OCI practitioner who wants to do the most technically demanding Oracle Cloud work available, this role is built for you.

About us:
Foodsmart is the leading telenutrition and foodcare solution, backed by a robust network of Registered Dietitians. Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver long-term health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide our 2.2 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG's Rise Fund to help expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

Our core values:

👥 Customer First — You start with the member and work backwards.

🚀 Make It Happen — You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.

🤝 One Team — You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

About the role:
Foodsmart's Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) team builds the telenutrition and foodcare platform used by members, providers, and partners. As a Senior Engineering Manager, you will lead and grow an engineering organization of approximately 16 engineers, setting technical direction and management practices that keep the team shipping reliable, high-quality software. You'll partner closely with product and design to translate roadmap priorities into well-architected systems, champion the adoption of AI throughout our engineering practices, and raise the bar on our full-stack web platform.

You will

  • Lead AI-native development: Bring strong, hands-on AI experience to guide teams building AI-native software products architected around AI from the ground up spanning agentic workflows, LLM-powered services, and AI-assisted engineering practices, not just AI-adjacent features.
  • Own four AI pods end to end: Directly manage four AI-focused pods, each accountable for delivering specific features and outcomes. You own execution, delivery, quality, and velocity across all four.
  • Manage cross-pod dependencies and risk: Identify where pods' roadmaps intersect, sequence work to avoid bottlenecks, and proactively surface and mitigate risks before they threaten delivery.
  • Shape architecture: Participate in and help drive architecture reviews across our React.js/TypeScript, Node.js, AWS, PostgreSQL, and Redshift stack, ensuring decisions hold up for scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability, including in a HIPAA/SOC 2-aware environment.

  • Drive engineering excellence: Raise the bar on code quality, testing, observability, incident response, and CI/CD practices across the pods.
  • Mentor and develop talent: Coach engineers and tech leads at all levels, building the next generation of technical leadership inside the org.
  • Communicate and collaborate: Act as a clear, consistent communicator and trusted partner across engineering, product, design, and leadership, translating technical realities for non-technical stakeholders and vice versa.

You are

  • A people-first, hands-on leader who invests in coaching engineers at every level and has led organizations of a similar size (10+ engineers).
  • A systems thinker who brings clarity to ambiguity, balances speed against risk, and earns trust across both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Calm under pressure, with crisp written, verbal, and executive communication, and comfortable making and documenting decisions.
  • Genuinely curious about AI, with real interest in its application to both engineering workflows and product development , not just familiarity with the term.
  • Highly adaptable, quick to pivot as priorities shift, consistently responsive, and detail-oriented without losing sight of the bigger picture.
  • An outcome-driven operator who ties engineering decisions back to measurable business and member impact.

You have

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including 5+ years managing engineering teams, with a track record leading 10+ engineers (startup or high-growth environment preferred).
  • Strong, hands-on AI-native development experience building products with agentic systems, LLM integrations, or AI-first architectures and a track record applying AI to both engineering workflows and product features.
  • A proven track record managing multiple engineering teams simultaneously, with clear accountability for delivery, quality, and velocity.
  • Experience managing cross-team dependencies and risk in a fast-moving, multi-pod environment.
  • Experience running engineering delivery with Agile/Lean practices (Scrum/Kanban) using tools like Jira and Confluence.
  • A track record of setting technical direction and making sound architecture decisions for scalable, full-stack web applications.

  • DynamoDB), PostgreSQL, and Redshift, along with Docker/Kubernetes for containerized, orchestrated deployments, and familiarity with GraphQL and RESTful API design.

    • Tools we use:

OUR BENEFITS & PERKS

About Amperity—Why This, Why Now

Most customer data is a lie by omission.

Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap—between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true—is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.

With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being—in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands—like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running—trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.

Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company—not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.

So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like—alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus—this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.

We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.

The Role

At Amperity, engineers work in small, collaborative feature teams. As an SDE IV, you'll contribute across teams that move quickly, embracing rapid, iterative development to solve meaningful customer problems and improve the platform. Engineers are involved in shaping what we build and how we build it, working with Product, Support, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams to create high-impact features and seamless customer experiences. We keep our processes lightweight, our communication clear, and our focus on delivering value.

As one of the first teammates building our footprint in Argentina, you’ll play a meaningful role in our growth and be part of shaping this new chapter from the beginning.

Interesting Problems

  • Ingest and understand large amounts of structured customer, product, and event data
  • Create probabilistic knowledge graphs by training ML models to unify this data across different systems
  • Take research algorithms and realize them in production for extremely high-scale usage
  • Build visual experiences and toolset to help users visualize their data, understand their customers and surface the most impactful insights
  • Integrate our system into the operating core of the businesses we serve
  • Automate the management of thousands of VMs running data processing jobs

About You

  • 12+ years industry experience working in SaaS and distributed systems environments
  • Experience working with large-scale data-oriented systems on a major cloud provider
  • You show deep technical judgment, expanding to the depths of your team's technology ownership. You impart this judgment on others and are sought for advice on all aspects of your team's product, process, and technology.
  • You can guide architectural decisions on your team and across teams with an eye to high-level tradeoffs, and know when and how to explore novel approaches. You are a backstop for oncall issues on your team.
  • Passionate about building scalable infrastructure systems for both internal and external customers
  • Excited about using functional languages (like Clojure!) in a production environment - Clojure or functional language experience isn't required
  • You educate those outside your team on your team's technology and products. You mentor those on your team and contribute to their growth. You take opportunities to share your unique talents and interests across the whole engineering team in the form of tools, education, excellence in interviewing, onboarding, or leading various special interest groups

Location

Argentina - Remote

This role is remote, with a small number of meaningful in-person gatherings designed to support alignment and collaboration.

Compensation & Benefits

We offer a competitive compensation package, along with benefits designed to support your well-being and long-term growth. Our total rewards program includes base compensation, benefits, and the opportunity to participate in our company’s equity plan.

Amperity is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, and reproductive health choices), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as someone with a disability, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law.

Location: Remote – Latin America Preferred (Must overlap with U.S. time zones)

Type of Contract: Full-Time | Remote

Salary Range: Market Rates

We are seeking a skilled Senior AI/Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Python, AI orchestration, and cloud-native backend systems to join our growing team. You will play a key role in developing a scalable, production-ready AI Voice Dispatch Assistant operating entirely within a secure AWS environment. Your work will directly impact the reliability, intelligence, and scalability of a multi-agent voice AI platform.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain a multi-agent AI system using Strands Agents SDK (BidiAgent) deployed on AWS ECS/Fargate, ensuring per-session isolation, auto-scaling, and lifecycle management of Nova 2 Sonic BidirectionalStream.
  • Develop and maintain high-performance backend services and APIs using FastAPI, including centralized API client libraries for Member Services, Dispatch, Coverage, and Eligibility workflows.
  • Build robust backend features such as Pydantic-based data models, field-level PII masking, audit logging, and endpoint-level caching strategies.
  • Implement LLM orchestration and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, including triage super-agent routing using Nova Micro and specialized sub-agent delegation.
  • Integrate AWS Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch Serverless, and Titan embeddings to ground AI responses using technical documentation and domain-specific knowledge.
  • Configure security, compliance, and content protection controls, including Bedrock Guardrails, AWS Cognito authentication, FastAPI JWT middleware, and Lambda-based authorization mechanisms.
  • Develop and manage serverless infrastructure components including API Gateway, AWS Lambda handlers, DynamoDB session state management, and ElastiCache Redis integrations.

Must-Have Qualifications

  • 5+ years of senior-level software engineering experience with a strong focus on Python development.
  • Extensive experience building scalable, resilient backend systems and APIs, preferably using FastAPI.
  • Strong hands-on expertise with AI/ML concepts, including LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
  • Deep knowledge of AWS services including ECS/Fargate, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, and AWS Bedrock services such as Nova 2 Sonic and Nova Micro.
  • Experience with multi-agent AI architecture frameworks such as Strands Agents SDK or similar technologies.
  • Solid understanding of authentication, security, and compliance best practices, including PII handling, prompt-injection protection, and access control systems.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across distributed teams while maintaining consistent overlap with U.S. business hours.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building production-grade voice AI or conversational AI systems.
  • Familiarity with OpenSearch Serverless, Titan embeddings, and AWS-native RAG implementations.
  • Experience designing secure, enterprise-grade AI solutions within controlled cloud environments.
  • Background working with healthcare, dispatch, or operational workflow automation platforms.

raw.excerpt: About UsSince 1989, SHI International Corp.  has helped organizations change the world through technology.
raw.description:
About Us

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

We are expanding our Snowflake capability within the Data and AI practice, and we are looking for a Principal Solutions Architect to lead the technical side of it.

You will be in front of customers from the start, qualifying opportunities, running technical discovery with customer architects and data leaders, designing target platforms, and owning the technical win. Most of the work in front of us is focused on platform build-out and migration, helping enterprises consolidate onto Snowflake from SAP, Oracle, Teradata, and other established estates. This is where we need the strongest expertise.

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant influence over what we build and sell. It is ideal for someone who wants to shape a capability rather than operate within one that is already established.

Role Description

Own the Technical Side of Snowflake Pursuits

  • Lead qualification, discovery, target architecture design, effort and risk sizing, and development of technical content for proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs).

  • Build and maintain technical relationships with customer architects and technical stakeholders.

  • Provide accurate assessments of migration effort, complexity, and risk, helping customers understand the true scope of their transformation initiatives.

Provide Architectural Oversight Through Delivery

  • Review architecture decisions throughout delivery.

  • Ensure the delivered solution aligns with what was originally scoped and proposed.

  • Identify and address risks or issues early in the project lifecycle.

  • Remain engaged in delivery to maintain accountability for the technical solution and outcomes.

Shape Snowflake Service Offerings

  • Define the technical content of Snowflake-focused service offerings.

  • Establish service scope, success criteria, and measurable outcomes.

  • Determine what evidence demonstrates successful delivery.

  • Create repeatable frameworks and standards that delivery teams can execute consistently.

Partner with Snowflake

  • Collaborate directly with Snowflake field teams and specialist architects on joint customer engagements.

  • Build productive relationships with vendor teams while representing the organization’s technical perspective.

  • Effectively navigate technical challenges, feedback, and differing viewpoints from Snowflake architects and specialists

Behaviors and Competencies

  • Willingness to Learn: Can apply new learning to daily work, encourage and facilitate learning in others, and actively make changes to work based on feedback.

  • Self-Development: Can demonstrate a commitment to continuous learning and adaptability to new ideas and methods.

  • Leadership: Can take ownership of complex team initiatives, collaborate with others in decision-making processes, and drive team performance.

  • Strategic Thinking: Can analyze complex situations, anticipate future trends, and align and integrate strategies across departments or functions.

  • Problem-Solving: Can proactively identify and take ownership of complex problem-solving initiatives, initiate preventative measures, collaborate with others to find solutions, and drive successful outcomes.

  • Analytical Thinking: Can use advanced analytical techniques to solve complex problems, draw insights, and communicate the solutions effectively.

  • Prioritization: Can take ownership of complex task management, collaborate with others to align priorities, and drive team efficiency.

  • Customer-Centric Mindset: Can take ownership of customer-centric initiatives, ensuring products and services align with customer needs. Collaborates with cross-functional teams to integrate customer feedback into product development.

  • Organization: Can oversee complex projects with multiple moving parts, ensure team alignment with organizational systems, and adapt to changing priorities.

  • Communication: Can effectively communicate complex ideas and information to diverse audiences, facilitate effective communication between others, and mentor others in effective communication.

  • Interpersonal Skills: Can communicate effectively, build relationships, resolve conflicts, influence others, and support others in developing their interpersonal skills in major situations.

Skill Level Requirements

Platform and Architecture

  • Account and environment design

  • Warehouse and compute architecture

  • Open table format strategy

  • Connectivity and data residency design

  • Cost architecture decisions that impact long-term scalability and affordability

The ability to design platforms that remain operationally and financially sustainable at scale is critical.

Migration and Consolidation

  • Migrating enterprises from SAP, Oracle, Teradata, SQL Server, appliance platforms, and increasingly other cloud data warehouses

  • Assessments and migration planning

  • Wave planning and execution

  • Schema and workload conversion

  • Reconciliation and parity validation

  • Cutover planning and execution

Experience extracting data from tightly licensed ERP environments is highly valuable, including understanding:

  • Inherited semantic layers

  • Data extraction challenges

  • Commercial licensing considerations

This represents the largest body of work anticipated for the practice and requires genuine expertise rather than general familiarity.

Data Engineering and Pipelines

  • Data ingestion

  • Data transformation

  • Pipeline orchestration

  • Testing frameworks

  • Data quality instrumentation

  • Building reliable, production-ready engineering processes rather than proof-of-concept implementations

Semantic and Context Layer

Experience designing and implementing:

  • Consistent business definitions that can be used across the organization

  • Shared semantic layers consumable by people, BI tools, and AI agents

  • Enterprise data models that ensure consistency across downstream consumers

This is an area of increasing investment within Snowflake and an area where many customers require significant guidance.

Governance at the Perimeter

Experience with:

  • Data classification

  • Access policies

  • Data masking

  • Lineage management

Candidates should understand how Snowflake governance integrates with enterprise governance frameworks and be able to address governance challenges that cross platform boundaries.

Consumption Economics

Strong understanding of:

  • Credit consumption management

  • Warehouse sizing

  • Workload placement strategies

  • Cost optimization and monitoring

Candidates must be able to speak confidently with customers about platform costs and provide practical guidance on maintaining cost efficiency.

Technical Depth Expectations

Candidates do not need to be equally strong across all six areas; however, they must possess:

  • Deep expertise in platform architecture

  • Deep expertise in migration and consolidation

  • Deep expertise in data engineering

  • Sufficient proficiency across the remaining areas to identify when specialist support is needed

Other Requirements

Snowflake Expertise

  • Substantial hands-on Snowflake experience gained through:

    • A Snowflake partner organization

    • Snowflake directly

    • Managing a significant Snowflake environment internally

  • This role requires Snowflake-specific expertise rather than general data platform leadership experience.

Enterprise Migration Experience

  • Proven experience delivering enterprise-scale migration and consolidation initiatives.

  • Ability to discuss at least one major migration engagement in detail, including lessons learned and outcomes.

  • Experience moving data from SAP and Oracle environments is particularly valuable.

Principal-Level Technical Leadership

  • Demonstrated success operating at Principal Architect level or equivalent.

  • Recognized as the senior technical authority in customer engagements.

  • Trusted to commit organizations to technical approaches, architectures, and delivery scopes.

Presales Experience

  • Experience in presales environments, or

  • Delivery leadership experience with demonstrated ability to:

    • Lead customer discussions

    • Define scope and approach

    • Develop proposals and Statements of Work

    • Stand behind commitments made during the sales process

Vendor Collaboration

  • Comfortable collaborating with and being challenged by vendor architects and technical specialists.

Certifications

  • Snowflake certification preferred.

  • Ability to obtain certification quickly if not already certified.

  • Certification support and funding are provided

The estimated annual pay range for this position is $195,000 - $250,000 which includes a base salary and bonus. The compensation for this position is dependent on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and market location and, therefore, will vary from individual to individual. Benefits may include, but are not limited to, medical, vision, dental, 401K, and flexible spending.

Equal Employment Opportunity – M/F/Disability/Protected Veteran Status

※後半に日本語の説明があります

C# software engineering position in a highly-growing startup, developing a document IDE for non-engineers.

About BoostDraft

BoostDraft is a software engineering company that develops IDE for documents. It was founded by MIT and Stanford grad students, developing an assisted document editor for documents. It is a new document editor that employs error checking, reference checking and auto-completion using both rule-based approach and NLP, like what coding editors/IDE (e.g. VSCode, Pycharm) do.

Please find more information here:

Background & Traction

We are currently focusing on Lawyers who draft relatively standardized but long documents, such as contracts. With only four years after our product launch, we already have more than 10,000 active paid users. We have several long-term, large-scale contracts with famed enterprises and law firms. As a result, we achieved significant success, including profitability and exponential growth, all without relying on external funding for nearly four years.

BoostDraft was accepted by prestigious accelerator program, MassChallenge (Top 30 US accelerator), StartX (Stanford Accelerator, 7% acceptance rate), MIT Sandbox (Accelerator of Massachusetts Institute of Technology)

Join our Engineering-First Team

At BoostDraft, we prioritize quality over quantity. As an engineering-first company. Around 50-60% of our team members are software engineers with extensive experiences from companies such as Microsoft, IBM, HTC, Yahoo!, and R&D in NTT.

Technical Challenges We Solve

  • Performance improvement using both partial analysis and full analysis
  • Synchronization between user input and on-memory text
  • Cache efficiency to increase highlight performance t during/after user input
  • Security preserving Natural Language Processing, such as Federated Learning

What’s your challenge

As a C# Software Engineer at BoostDraft, you will be tackling challenging technical problems, including:

  • Design and implement classes and methods for IDE for documents
  • Refactor existing code for better extensibility
  • Interview with our users to understand their daily work and pain points
  • Propose both innovative ideas and feasible ideas to achieve unprecedented features

【Languages】 C#,（partially）Rust, Python

【FW】.NET Framework 4.8, .NET 8.0

【DB】 SQLite, Amazon RDS

【Log Analysis】 AWS CloudWatch, Elasticsearch + Kibana, BigQuery

【CI/CD】 GitHub, GitHub Actions（Self-hosted runner (Windows)）, Azure DevOps

Ensuring a Fair and Secure Recruitment Process:

In recent years, there has been a growing number of applications submitted with fake or AI-generated profiles, including fabricated work history or impersonated identities. At BoostDraft, we are committed to providing a fair and secure hiring process for all candidates and have implemented the following measures:

  • During online interviews, the use of both camera and microphone is mandatory. If we detect suspicious behavior, we may ask you to disable video filters or perform a simple on-screen action. If you are unable or unwilling to comply, the interview may be terminated on the spot.
  • By applying for a position or participating in an interview, you are deemed to have agreed to these measures and to cooperate if such requests are reasonably made.

These measures are applied equally to all candidates to ensure a trustworthy and fair hiring environment. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

If you have any concerns or questions regarding these measures, please feel free to contact our recruiting team.

事業内容

弊社はVS CodeやIntelli J等のIDEのコンセプトを法務文書領域に適用した、支援機能付きドキュメントエディタの開発を行っております。

ソフトウェア開発者がIDEのさまざまな支援機能によって本質的なコーディングに集中できている事実に着想を得て、法律文書に特化した同様の支援機能をMicrosoft Wordのアドインとして実装することで、ユーザが法務文書作成時の本質的な作業に注力できるようにするものです。顧客の大半は弁護士事務所および企業法務部で、大規模・中規模弁護士事務所はほぼすべて、多数の大企業に導入していただいております。そして、創業からすぐに高い収益を上げたことから、約四年間にわたり外部からの資金調達を行わずに急激な成長を遂げました。

権威のあるアクセラレータープログラムである、MassChallenge (米国トップ30アクセラレータ)、StartX (スタンフォードアクセラレータ、採択率7%)、MIT Sandbox (マサチューセッツ工科大学アクセラレータ)に受け入れられてきた実績があります。

会社紹介資料:

BoostDraftの魅力:

  • プロダクト開発を中心とした組織作り
    • CEOのSeanをはじめとし、社員の約5割がエンジニア職で構成されており、各メンバーはMicrosoft, IBM, HTC, LINEヤフー, NTT研究所などの有力企業で経験を積んでいます。
  • 研究開発への投資
    • IDEの概念を応用し、バージョン管理・比較、パッケージ管理、プラグイン等、他のソフトウェアとの連携・拡張を実現する予定です。
  • 事業の成長性
    • 創業一年目から継続して黒字経営を行っているなど、日系スタートアップの中では稀な成長の軌跡を達成しています。すでに米国や韓国をはじめとした国外でも事業を展開しています。

私たちが解決する技術的課題:

  • 部分的解析と全体解析の両方を活用したパフォーマンスの向上
  • ユーザーの入力とオンメモリのテキスト間の同期
  • ユーザー入力中や入力後のハイライトのパフォーマンスを向上させるためのキャッシュ効率化
  • 連合学習（フェデレーテッド・ラーニング）など、セキュリティを保護しながら行う自然言語処理

業務内容:

C# ソフトウェアエンジニアとして、以下の技術的課題を解決いただきます：

・C＃を活用したクラス・インターフェース設計および実装

・拡張性を高めるための既存コードの再設計

・ユニットテスト記述
・効果的なアルゴリズムの開発
・チームメンバーが開発したコードのレビュー
・全体アーキテクチャ設計・技術選定
・顧客インタビューを通じた機能の詳細化
・新たな機能を実装するための革新的かつ実現可能なアイディアの提案

・心理的安全性の高い環境の構築

スキル・志向に応じて

・機能の優先順位付け

raw.description:
Remote, Philippines
Salary: 45k - 72k
Experience: 3-7 Yrs
Degree: Minimum Bachelor/Preferred Masters

Shift:

  • U.S. Eastern Time: 8:00 AM – 6:00 PM

  • Philippine Time:

    • 8:00 PM – 6:00 AM (during U.S. Daylight Saving Time)

    • 9:00 PM – 7:00 AM (during U.S. Standard Time)

Looking for Builders, Not Passengers

Most engineers are given maps.

We are looking for someone who creates the roadmap.

We are building an AI company at speed. The kind where the architecture decisions made in the next 12–18 months will define our company for the next decade.

This role is not for someone who wants a comfortable sprint cycle.

It’s for someone who wants to build systems that matter, someone who is comfortable assembling parts of an airplane while the airplane is in the air.

We are looking for a Driven and Talented Software Engineer who can operate with the ownership, speed, and sound judgment of a leader.

Someone who doesn’t wait to be pointed at problems.
Someone who hunts them and solves them graciously.

The Work

You won’t be maintaining legacy systems.

You’ll be building the core systems that drive change and impact a significant number of extremely reputable and large businesses.

That means:

  • Designing architecture that scales before the scale exists

  • Turning ambiguous ideas into production systems quickly

  • Shipping fast while protecting the parts that cannot break

  • Making technical decisions with long half-lives

You will have real ownership of critical infrastructure, product, and platform decisions.

When something blocks progress, you remove the blocker.

No drama. Just velocity.

The Kind of Engineer Who Thrives Here

This role is intentionally polarizing.

You’ll probably thrive here if:

  • You build things because you can’t help yourself

  • You care deeply about craft, performance, and elegant systems

  • You move faster than most teams while maintaining high standards

  • You learn new domains faster than most people can Google them

  • You default to ownership instead of permission

You likely have at least one project where:

  • you built something that was technically extremely difficult from scratch

  • people now depend on it

  • and you did it mostly because you wanted to see if it was possible

You have very high standards.

For your code.

For your thinking.

And especially for yourself.

 

What This Is Not

This is not:

  • a maintenance role

  • a Jira-ticket factory

  • a place to hide behind processes

  • an environment tolerant of mediocre engineering

We are building with controlled velocity:

Fast without being sloppy.

Ambitious without being reckless.

 

The Upside

If you are the right person, this will be one of the most leveraged periods of your career.

You’ll get:

  • Ownership over systems that matter

  • A small team of other high-agency builders

  • Real influence on product and architecture

  • Equity that actually means something if we win

  • A front-row seat to building an AI company’s new products from the ground up

 

The Filter

This role is not for everyone.

Most engineers prefer clear maps and tickets, predictable scope, and stable systems.

If reading this made you feel slightly uncomfortable and excited at the same time, you are probably the kind of builder we are looking for.

OVERVIEW

The Company

U.S. Financial Technology (U.S. FinTech) is seeking an experienced Enterprise Risk Management Data Analytics Lead to join our team of talented professionals. This is a full-time remote opportunity.

U.S. FinTech built and operates the largest and most advanced mortgage securitization platform in the world, supporting the Uniform Mortgage-Backed Security (UMBS) of Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac.

Supporting 70% of the mortgage-backed securities in the market, U.S. FinTech provides best-in-class single-family issuance, bond administration, disclosure, and tax services. We support a broad portfolio of products for our clients with full lifecycle management.

Our market-leading, cloud-based, end-to-end platform executes transactions on an extraordinary scale which has bolstered liquidity in the secondary mortgage market, one of the largest and most important financial markets in the world. Our unique approach to securitization combines the best minds in financial services with the know-how, flexibility, and innovation of leading technologists.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Job InformationThis individual will work as part of the U.S. FinTech's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) function to provide timely reporting across multiple Risk Programs which evaluate the risk and controls structures surrounding the Issuance and administration of GSE Mortgage-Backed Securities. They will be the ERM team’s primary technical resource for designing, developing, and executing data analytics-related activities for KRI, KI trending, graphing/visual display pan ERM. The role would utilize various technologies for the automation of reporting on Risk & Control Self Assessments, operational events, issues and related validations. Role would liaise with ERM management regarding the reporting of ERM data for governance forums.

Key Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and maintain enterprise risk management dashboards, executive scorecards, KPI frameworks, and analytics solutions using Power BI and other business intelligence of AI platforms.
  • Partner with business stakeholders to define metrics, gather and validate requirements, refine business questions, and translate needs into scalable reporting and analytics solutions.
  • Analyze business performance, risk indicators, and operational trends to identify opportunities, emerging risks, recurring issues, and areas for improvement.
  • Deliver meaningful insights and recommendations that support strategic decision-making, operational effectiveness, and business performance objectives.
  • Automate, optimize, and enhance recurring reporting processes to improve efficiency, scalability, accuracy, timeliness, and user adoption.
  • Support the development and adoption of advanced analytics capabilities, including AI-enabled reporting, predictive insights, and intelligent automation for ERM AI use cases.
  • Ensure the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of reporting through data validation, reconciliation, testing, quality assurance, and documentation standards.
  • Communicate complex analytical findings clearly and effectively to executives, business leaders, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships across business, technology, risk, compliance, audit, and other cross-functional teams to drive reporting maturity and continuous improvement.
  • Advance reporting and analytics capabilities by promoting trusted data standards, process optimization, automation, and data-driven decision-making.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Analytics, Business, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Certifications preferred: CISA.
  • Other nice to have certifications: AWS Certified Data Analytics, IBM Data Analyst Professional, Google Data Analytics Professional.

Minimum Experience

  • Minimum of 7-8 years of management experience in enterprise risk, operational risk management
  • Applicants must be authorized to work in the US without requiring employer sponsorship currently or in the future. U.S. FinTech does not offer H-1B sponsorship for this position.

Specialized Knowledge & Skills

  • Proven expertise designing, developing, and maintaining enterprise-scale dashboards, executive scorecards, KPI frameworks, and business intelligence solutions.
  • Advanced analytical and quantitative skills with the ability to transform complex datasets into actionable business insights and recommendations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Power BI, including data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard architecture, performance optimization, and executive reporting.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, and PostgreSQL, including data extraction, transformation, automation, analytical modeling, and reporting solutions.
  • Demonstrated success partnering with senior stakeholders to translate complex business challenges into scalable analytical and reporting solutions.
  • Proven ability to analyze business performance, identify trends, risks, and opportunities, and influence strategic and operational decision-making through data-driven recommendations.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, stakeholder management, and consultative influencing skills across all organizational levels.
  • Proven ability to operate independently in a highly visible individual contributor role while leading initiatives and influencing outcomes across teams.
  • Track record of delivering measurable business value through reporting innovation, process optimization, automation, and analytics-driven improvements.
  • Extensive experience ensuring data integrity, governance, and reporting accuracy through validation, reconciliation, testing, quality assurance, and documentation practices.
  • Experience leveraging advanced analytics, predictive modeling, AI-enabled reporting, machine learning, or intelligent automation capabilities.
  • Experience within risk management, enterprise risk, compliance, audit, third-party risk, fintech, financial services, or other highly regulated environments strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with Mortgage / Securitization market processes a plus.

Pay Range $156,500 to $181,000

Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law. Employment

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

In this role, you will be a trusted technical advisor, helping clients design, deploy, and scale AI solutions while managing large-scale GPU workloads involving hundreds to thousands of GPUs. You will also collaborate with sales and product teams to drive growth and enhance customer satisfaction.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States or Canada.

Your responsibilities will include:

It will be an added bonus if you have:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
